correctness.rationale: Genericity of remaining columns makes every mixed 3-by-3 minor invertible on a dense open subset of the irreducible codimension-three five-column rank-deficiency variety. The local divisor is exactly the five-column determinantal arrangement times 3(n−5) smooth variables. By Janasz Theorem B(3), the rank-two five-column stalk needs 16 generators, giving 16+3(n−5)=3n+1; this is greater than rank 3n. Closedness extends containment to the full Z_J. Exact finite determinants were checked; generality rests on polynomial nonvanishing and module theory.
